_note: DEMAND_BREAKOUT v2 revalidation config. Shape is strategy-specific (legacy V0+V3' reconstruction with reconciliation/r_real/overlap blocks). The lab _schema/config.schema.json is currently CAPITULATION-shaped and would need generalization to formally validate this config; it is NOT modified in this patch. config.json is the single source of parameters the future backtest script reads; methodology.md references it.

signal.legacy_rule: V0+V3': inside_demand_zone AND nas_dist_ema_atr in [1.0,2.0] AND dist_14d_pct in [-1.0,0.0]
signal.dist_14d_window_note: 84 = 14 calendar days x 6 4H bars/day; 40 = the live monitor's ohlcv_last_40_bars (~6.6 days). Test both in reconciliation; confirm which the legacy used (caveat C3).
signal.custom_ob_state_note: legacy used presence only (IN_OB_ZONE); fresh/touched/mitigated is a sensitivity variant, not the legacy rule

reconciliation.on_reproduction_failure: STOP and audit; classify as signal/data mismatch before any merit decision

overlap.episode_definition: TBD in script after observing clusters: contiguous run of full-signal bars and/or bars sharing the same demand zone

decision_gates.philosophy: 2-stage (technical validity then merit), per _schema/DECISION_FLOW.md and STATUS_TAXONOMY.md
decision_gates.close_only_reproduction_failure_action: classify reconciliation as signal/data mismatch before merit decision
